record.question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct about 'increment'?
I. Increment should not be drawn as a matter of course
II. Extraordinary leave granted to a Government servant due to his inability to rejoin duty on account of civil commotion counts for increment
III. Increment is generally not granted to a probationer
IV. Increment may also be granted to a Government servant on leave
options: Only I, II & III are correct
record.explanation: Only statements I, II and III about increment are correct.
